step1_analysis.circuit_type: Temporal Output Coding / Integrate-and-Fire Pixel Output
step1_analysis.description: This circuit converts an analog state into a temporal pulse width (address-event coding). A memory/threshold node (MEMTH) is reset to ground and then charged by a bias current, while output PMOS switches generate pulses on PULSEX, PULSEY, and FREEZE until MEMTH reaches the threshold.

paper_reference.title: A 100 100 Pixel Silicon Retina for Gradient Extraction With Steering Filter Capabilities and Temporal Output Coding

t_pulse_x.description: Pulse width on PULSEX (time from RESET release to output falling edge)

sky130_expected.calculation: Charging current I_chg ~ 1uA (N6=1.4V). C_MEM = 50fF. dV/dt = 20V/us. PMOS turns off at VDD - |Vth| = 1.3V. t = 1.3V / 20V/us = 65ns.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the bias voltage N6 and the parasitic/explicit capacitance on MEMTH. Tuned to match the 60ns delay reported in the paper.

t_reset.description: Time to discharge MEMTH to ground when RESET is asserted

sky130_expected.calculation: NMOS W=5u L=0.5u has Ron ~ 1kOhm. C_MEM = 50fF. RC time constant = 50ps.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Discharge is extremely fast due to the large W/L of the reset transistor.

sky130_expected.calculation: I_PX ~ 36uA (VTH=1.0V), I_PY ~ 1uA (N6=1.4V), I_chg ~ 1uA. Total active current ~ 40uA during the pulse.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by the output current on PULSEX which is set by VTH.

step3_testbench.description: Transient analysis to measure the temporal pulse widths generated on the output buses after a reset event.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Testbench for Temporal Output Coding Circuit
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xmchg=5u L_xmchg=0.5u
.param W_xmsc=5u L_xmsc=0.5u
.param W_xmfr=5u L_xmfr=0.5u
.param W_xmpy=5u L_xmpy=0.5u
.param W_xmpx=5u L_xmpx=0.5u
.param W_xmsx=5u L_xmsx=0.5u
.param W_xmrst=5u L_xmrst=0.5u
.param W_xmsy=5u L_xmsy=0.5u
.param W_xmsf=5u L_xmsf=0.5u

VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VN6 N6 0 1.4
VVTH VTH 0 1.0
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.0
VRESET RESET 0 PULSE(1.8 0 10n 1n 1n 100n 200n)

R_PX PULSEX 0 1Meg
R_PY PULSEY 0 1Meg
R_PF FREEZE 0 1Meg

C_MEM MEMTH 0 50f

XMCHG MEMTH BIAS N5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmchg} w={W_xmchg}
XMSC N5 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmsc} w={W_xmsc}
XMFR N0 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmfr} w={W_xmfr}
XMPY N3 N6 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmpy} w={W_xmpy}
XMPX N1 VTH VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmpx} w={W_xmpx}
XMSX PULSEX MEMTH N1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmsx} w={W_xmsx}
XMRST MEMTH RESET GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xmrst} w={W_xmrst}
XMSY PULSEY MEMTH N3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmsy} w={W_xmsy}
XMSF FREEZE MEMTH N0 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xmsf} w={W_xmsf}

.control
tran 1n 200n
meas tran t_pulse_x trig v(RESET) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(PULSEX) val=0.9 fall=1
meas tran t_pulse_y trig v(RESET) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(PULSEY) val=0.5 fall=1
meas tran t_pulse_f trig v(RESET) val=0.9 fall=1 targ v(FREEZE) val=0.5 fall=1
meas tran t_reset trig v(RESET) val=0.9 rise=1 targ v(MEMTH) val=0.1 fall=1
meas tran avg_current avg i(VVDD)
quit
.endc
